---
title: "Ask it to explain, then confirm by running"
---

*The assistant as Explainer: an explanation is useful but provisional.*

::: {.callout-note}
## Draft stub — planned contents
A student pastes an error or a short piece of code and asks the assistant to explain it, then confirms the explanation by running the code and reading what actually happens. Teaches that an explanation is worth having but is not yet knowledge, and that running the code is how you find out whether the explanation was right.
:::
